name: tree
title: Tree
description: A nested list of items that open and close, with one selected item.
a11y: role=tree with treeitem children and role=group for branches; aria-expanded on branches, aria-selected on every item, aria-level on each.
Roving tabindex: one item is in the tab order; Tab enters and leaves the tree as one stop.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move, ArrowRight opens a branch then enters it, ArrowLeft closes it then goes to the parent, Home and End jump.
Enter or Space selects; typing letters jumps to the next label that starts with them. The tree needs an aria-label.
